name: Space
description: Twelve maps above the clouds and beyond: a floating sky station, a planet you can walk all the way round, a salvage yard and a binary asteroid that mix gravity fields (walls, low gravity, rocks with their own pull), an orbital shipyard, a lunar mining outpost, a generation-ship arboretum, a fusion reactor hall, an asteroid refinery, a terraforming processor, a cryo-vault and a neon spaceport bazaar.
author: Call of Slop
